prompts.scenePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE complete continuous painted BASE COURTYARD for a portrait fantasy mobile tower-defense game, portrait 3:4 canvas. Input image 1 (approved shop interior) is STYLE ONLY: match its crisp espresso outlines, purposeful 2-3 broad cel-shaded value planes, chunky sandstone and oak, blue heraldic banners, warm sunlight and cool shadows. Input image 2 (small blue-roof castle icon) is CASTLE IDENTITY only. Render a sunny royal expedition settlement from a single elevated three-quarter camera. All architecture and ground belong to one coherent illustration with consistent scale, upper-left lighting and contact shadows. Main subject: exactly three readable functional buildings. TOP CENTER, centered around x50% y43%, a stout sandstone MAIN KEEP with three blue cone roofs, one small blue flag, blue-gold banners, wooden arched gate and two short stone steps; its foundation ends near y59%. LOWER LEFT centered at x24% y73%, a smaller scholarly RESEARCH ACADEMY with teal/navy roof, one modest bronze observatory cap, one small cyan crystal inset, arched entrance and a single open book on a short lectern beside the door; its foundation ends near y86%. LOWER RIGHT centered at x76% y74%, a compact unfinished TIMBER WORKSHOP with gray slate roof, chimney, simple scaffold on one side, one anvil and a couple of stacked beams; foundation ends near y87%. Academy and workshop are similar size, visibly smaller than the keep. Leave a narrow clear gap between their silhouettes. Each building is fully visible, with recognizable doorway, attached foundation flush on the SAME ground. No floating islands, isolated asset patches or fake platforms. Scene surrounds them: warm pale ochre paved/dirt courtyard and forked cobblestone paths connect doors, 2-3 clumps of green foliage at the sides, low boundary walls, wooden palisade at rear, deep navy-green trees, a small distant cool blue ridge and clear sky at top. TOP 20% quiet sky/treetops and distant wall shadows reserved for overlay currency and title; no foreground building in this band. Keep outer edges quiet and keep all important features within central 86% width. Lower 10% open ground suitable for code labels. Add thoughtful foreground/middle/background layering, warm sandstone against cool blue roofs and lush green. Simple deliberately designed geometry and recognizable silhouettes, 4-6 large roof tile bands at most, a few intentional stone joints, no tiny repeated busy props. Fully opaque image, no UI labels, no text, no symbols hovering over buildings, no interface controls, no people/creatures. Avoid soft airbrush, plastic 3D, photoreal grain, filigree, excessive shiny gold, glow/bloom, volumetric fog, floating dust, lens blur, vignetting, cinematic AI lighting. A practical attractive hand-drawn comic game environment, as clean and controlled as the approved shop illustration.
